text: Confirmed and filed #6592: APPEND FROM TYPE CSV trims significant leading spaces inside quoted character fields. Native VFP9 COM preserves "  X  " (first char ASCII 32; third is X), while Copperfin imports X (first char 88; third is blank). Current tokenizer applies trim_copy to quoted and unquoted fields alike. Distinct from #6579 multiline parsing and #6591 BOM header handling. Issue verified OPEN and owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes.
